[NFCT.2.8] **The slot types are the registry `specs/registry/slot_type.ebnf`.**
`ds_slot_type_t` must mirror it name for name and value for value. It is the
type `ds_schema_get_slot` reads back for a loaded schema's slot ([NFCT.1.4.1])
and the type [NFCT.2.3] pairs a value's kind with. Its numbers are its own: it
is not a mirror of the artefact's `proto/slot.proto#SlotKind`.
